title: R10 handoff of requests made before the lifecycle cutover, and the deployed canary rollback

environment.stack: chaos compose project hawa-chaos (Postgres, Restate 1.7.10, Core, blue and green workers, fakes), built from this checkout; synthetic Telegram, Canva, Google and model fakes; internal network only
environment.configuration_at_start: HAWA_TELEGRAM_POLLER=core, HAWA_LIFECYCLE_CHATS set but empty (production before 2026-09-28 ~20:55)
environment.deploy_model: packages/testkit/chaos/driver/cutover.ts follows infra/docker/deploy.sh (ADR-129): step 7 recreates Core with the new chat list and the held poller (core while moving to worker; not held when moving back), 7b creates the idle colour with the new values and registers it with scripts/restate-bluegreen.ts, release_core_poller recreates Core with the wanted poller, finish-drains deletes the old colour, its container is removed
environment.lock: hawa-chaos-lock container taken before the first down (ported from claude/objective-hellman-2d66cb); other checkouts' runs held it for most of the evening and were waited for, never torn down
environment.production: not touched: no SQL, no docker commands against hawa-production-*, no deploy

defects_found_and_fixed.what: In a lifecycle chat, a Telegram reply to a Core message (draft, change prompt, clarification question, delivered file) was refused as STALE_REQUEST_REPLY ('That design is no longer waiting for changes'), even in a chat with no lifecycle request
defects_found_and_fixed.red: unit: 3 cases failed; chaos R10.H1 red: B, D and E refused (stale reply refusal), D's photo never downloaded
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: coreOwnedUpdate (apps/core/src/services/lifecycle-chat-target.ts) gives such replies to legacy intake before lifecycle routing (reply names a Core-pinned task of the chat; reply to an outbox send of such a task; any reply in a chat with Core history and no lifecycle request)

defects_found_and_fixed.what: A Core button press (callback data rq:ok:<task>) in a chat where a lifecycle request waited for the requester was projected as that request's revision directive (a paid revision reading 'rq:ok:...')
defects_found_and_fixed.red: unit: lifecycleAction 'requester-revision' returned for a callback query
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: every callback query in a lifecycle chat goes to legacy intake (lifecycle notices carry no buttons)

defects_found_and_fixed.what: An ordinary brief opened a lifecycle request only in a chat with no Core-pinned task ever; all 15 production chats had Core history and nothing tells requesters about /new
defects_found_and_fixed.red: unit: open-request not returned for 49-hour-old history; chaos R10.H1 red: C's aged-history brief stayed legacy
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: only a Core-pinned task created in the last 48 hours (legacy intake's own reading window) holds a chat to legacy intake

defects_found_and_fixed.what: After a rollback of the poller to Core, a requester's reply to a lifecycle request waiting for it went to legacy intake: it became a new Core task ('Brief received and queued in Hawa Desk') while the request stayed at manual rev 3 (stranded, a second owner for the same change)
defects_found_and_fixed.red: unit: 2 of 3 poller cases failed; chaos R10.K1 red: R's request stayed rev 3, a Core task 332a8d72 appeared, no ChatInbox invocation for the reply
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Core's poller sends updates from a chat with any Restate-owned request to that chat's ChatInbox with key tg-<update_id> (apps/core/src/services/polled-lifecycle-route.ts, apps/core/src/app.ts)

observed_not_changed: Legacy intake answers 'Thank you, we received the files.' after a delivery, and a captioned photo replying to a delivered file, by queueing a new manual Desk task ('Brief received and queued in Hawa Desk'). The control chat G shows it does so under the old configuration too; the handed-off chat D got the same answers.

A legacy change after a draft (B, E) is held for the native Canva handoff (ADR-113: task failed_operator, 'Revision saved for native editing'); a lifecycle requester revision after an office revision is held the same way (ADR-114). Neither was carried through native recovery here.

A legacy clarification question lives in Core's memory; after the Core restart every deploy makes, the requester's 'revise' became a change request (E: one Core revision), which is what the legacy handler does with 'revise' without the pending question.

red_before_fix.handoff_cases: 6 run: 5 failed, 1 passed (the stale-reply regression guard)
red_before_fix.poller_cases: 3 run: 2 failed, 1 passed (legacy chat stays legacy)

unit_tests.affected_files_after_fix: 12 files, 150 tests passed (lifecycle-internal-intake, chat-intake-flag-scoping, lifecycle-cutover-handoff, request-log-context, split-g9-telegram-intake, telegram-intake-edges, lifecycle-revision-round, lifecycle-full-journey, lifecycle-album, lifecycle-source, telegram-polling-waits-for-client-dna, lifecycle-voice)

updates_after_the_switch_checked_one_cha.R10.H1: 9 of 9 (including one read while Core and the new colour both polled)
updates_after_the_switch_checked_one_cha.R10.K1: 4 of 4 (including one read while both polled in the rollback, and R's reply while Core polled)

operator_rollback_steps: With a build that has ADR-136: set HAWA_TELEGRAM_POLLER=core in infra/docker/.env and HAWA_LIFECYCLE_CHATS= (empty) in infra/docker/.env.production; run bash infra/docker/deploy.sh, then --apply.

Check the deploy output: deleted=<old colour> from finish-drains (a delivery in flight keeps the old colour draining until it finishes; the next deploy finishes the drain), Core /v1/health names poller core, the new colour's /health shows telegramPoller off.

Finish open lifecycle requests in the Desk as usual; their requesters' replies still reach them through ChatInbox, so Restate and a registered worker colour must stay up. Nothing has to be re-sent or moved.
Roll forward the same way with worker and *; Core keeps polling until the new colour is registered.

With the build running in production on 2026-09-28 (before ADR-136) do not roll the poller back while any lifecycle request waits for its requester: roll back HAWA_LIFECYCLE_CHATS only (keep HAWA_TELEGRAM_POLLER=worker). If the poller was rolled back anyway, a reply to a waiting request becomes a new Core task queued in the Desk and the request keeps waiting: the office must read the reply from that task (or the chat), cancel or close the queued Core task, and continue the request from the Desk (office revision) once the poller is forward again.
not_executed: No production run: no deploy, no rollback, no SQL, no container command on hawa-production-*.
A lifecycle awaiting_answer question (the fixtures have no Studio clarification stage); the waiting-for-the-requester state drilled is the office revision notice at rev 3.
Real Telegram (the fake serves getUpdates to both pollers and never answers 409), real Canva, Drive or models; human review quality.
Native revision recovery of the held revisions (ADR-113/114) and delivery of B, D, E's changes.
The chat-list-only rollback was run on the fixed build only; the update it drills (a reply to a lifecycle notice in a chat without Core history) takes no path ADR-136 changed.
Restate backup and clean-host restore (owned by another agent).
